mcq.s: Which committee submitted a report on domestic natural gas pricing, recommending complete pricing freedom from 1 January 2026?
o: More than one of the above
mcq.x: The Kirit Parikh Committee (2022) recommended a floor and ceiling price for gas from legacy (APM) fields and full market pricing freedom from 1 January 2026.

mcq.s:
Match List-I with List-II:
List-I
A. Sarkaria Commission
B. C. Rangarajan Committee
C. Parekh Committee
D. Narasimham Committee
List-II
1. Review of the methodology for measurement of poverty
2. Infrastructure financing
3. Centre-State relations
4. Banking sector reforms
mcq.x: Sarkaria – Centre-State relations; C. Rangarajan – poverty measurement methodology (2014); Deepak Parekh – infrastructure financing; Narasimham – banking sector reforms.

mcq.s: Which of the following statements signifies a 'pressure group'?
o: A group that works for social reform
A faction of a political party trying to win over others
A group that exercises its influence on policy decisions
A group that works for the welfare of the poor
mcq.x: A pressure group is an organised group that tries to influence public policy decisions without seeking to capture political power itself.

mcq.s: The Banaras Hindu University was founded by:
mcq.x: Pandit Madan Mohan Malaviya founded BHU in 1916 (BHU Act, 1915), with Annie Besant's Central Hindu College as its nucleus.

why: Consumer Protection Act 1986 replaced by 2019 Act

mcq.s: India was the first country to ratify the Marrakesh Treaty (2014). This treaty aims at:
o: Promoting access to published works for persons who are blind, visually impaired or print-disabled
mcq.x: The WIPO Marrakesh Treaty (2013) facilitates access to published works for blind, visually impaired and print-disabled persons; India ratified it first, on 30 June 2014.

why: printed key wrong and CSO since merged into NSO; answer outdated

mcq.s: Who used the concept of 'jail cost of living' to estimate the poverty line in India?
mcq.x: Dadabhai Naoroji, in 'Poverty and Un-British Rule in India', estimated a subsistence (poverty) line using the cost of maintaining a prisoner in jail.

mcq.s: Into how many adhikaranas (books) is Kautilya's Arthashastra divided?
mcq.x: The Arthashastra has 15 adhikaranas (books), 150 chapters and 180 prakaranas.

mcq.s: In the Vijayanagara administration, what was 'Athavane'?
mcq.x: Athavane was the revenue department of the Vijayanagara empire; Kandachara was the military department.

mcq.s:
Which of the following statements about the Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) are true?
I. It was established in 1997.
II. It is a statutory body.
III. It was set up to regulate telecom services, including fixing/revising tariffs.
IV. Its headquarters is in Mumbai.
mcq.x: TRAI was set up on 20 February 1997 under the TRAI Act, 1997 (statutory) to regulate telecom services and tariffs; its headquarters is in New Delhi.
